x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.projectRootRealpath: Every configured managed path and its nearest existing ancestor must resolve inside the canonical project root.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.managedRootSeparation: content, theme, public, output, .mallok and .git may not equal, contain or be contained by another managed root where CONTENT_CONFIG.md forbids overlap.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.symlinkAndJunctionPolicy: Content/theme/public traversal rejects symlinks and junctions; output replacement rechecks existing ancestors before each rename.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.pathByteAndDepthLimits: Runtime applies the UTF-8 byte, segment-count and file-count limits in CONTENT_CONFIG.md and BUILD.md because JSON Schema string length is not a byte or filesystem check.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.xmlSafeMetadata: site.title and site.description must be well-formed Unicode scalar sequences containing only XML 1.0 characters. The regex rejects expressible illegal code points; runtime additionally rejects lone surrogates and applies trim/code-point length exactly as CONTENT_CONFIG.md specifies.

url.description: Runtime URL parsing also validates the host and port; credentials, subpaths, query and fragment are forbidden.
Cloudflare target requires the canonical HTTPS root origin. Runtime additionally parses the URL, rejects userinfo and invalid ports, and normalizes one trailing slash.

relativePath.description: Lexical POSIX project-relative path only. Runtime additionally enforces at most 32 non-empty segments, 1,024 UTF-8 bytes total and 255 UTF-8 bytes per segment, plus the realpath/overlap/symlink constraints declared at the document root.
